findings.title: Family1 incremental-alpha Stage-A gate is evaluated on a formula the binding A5 proposal explicitly froze OUT of the gate (per-trade expectancy difference implemented; per-pair-day normalized difference is the frozen gate)

evidence.a5_proposal_frozen_gate: research/proposals/forex_free_v3/a5_lane/proposal_1.json incremental_test.operationalization: 'overall incremental alpha := (full-sample sum of the anchor's after-cost financing-adjusted per-pair-day PnL) - (same for the benchmark), both normalized per pair-day of the identical post-warmup schedule window, with identical notional units per active position. Gate: > 0. The per-trade expectancy difference (anchor - benchmark) is reported alongside as a diagnostic, not the gate.'
evidence.implemented: scored_runner.py compute_cell: bench_expectancy = per-trade mean of the benchmark's financing-adjusted book; incremental_alpha = book_metrics(pnls_fin)['expectancy'] - bench_expectancy; stage_a_gates fires INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE on exactly this value. No other code path evaluates the A5 per-pair-day formula.
evidence.family2_unaffected: a6_lane/proposal_1.json freezes 'anchor financing-adjusted expectancy minus benchmark financing-adjusted expectancy' as ITS gate - the implemented formula matches family2 verbatim
evidence.no_waiver: i_gates_fix.json documents the expectancy-difference formula but records no deviation against the A5 operationalization; w3_freeze.json delta_notes are silent on it
evidence.related_nuance: the A5 comparison window question ('identical post-warmup schedule window') is subsumed: the implemented per-trade difference performs no day-normalization at all, and the family1 benchmark's own state activates at its 21-bar momentum warmup (~2020-03) while the anchor activates at the 63-bar macro warmup (~2020-05)

findings.impact: The cycle's central incremental-information test for family1 is evaluated on a non-frozen formula. Per-trade and per-pair-day normalizations can differ in sign (the anchor trades a subset of the benchmark's active days; the A5 proposal froze per-pair-day normalization precisely for exposure fairness), so a family1 verdict under the implemented gate can contradict the verdict of its own frozen gate in either direction - a false Stage-A survivor or a false reject. Pre-registration integrity is broken for the family1 incremental gate even though no outcome data exists yet.
findings.required_remediation_before_any_scored_r: (a) implement the A5 frozen operationalization for family1:anchor inside compute_cell (pair-day normalized difference of full-sample financing-adjusted sums over the identical post-warmup schedule window; the per-trade difference stays reported as the proposal's diagnostic) - code delta, all seven code_hashes re-frozen, delta re-audit; OR (b) the owner records an explicit deviation waiver accepting the per-trade expectancy difference as the family1 gate (event_log + deviation register), formally superseding the A5 operationalization text.

findings.severity: HIGH (ruled); RESOLVED CONDITIONALLY per recorded A1 precommitment
findings.title: Dropout gate denominator moved from the frozen 5-of-7 to 5-of-8: strictly weaker
findings.ruling: WEAKER. The new gate's pass set is a strict superset of the frozen 5-of-7 gate: every book with >= 5 pair-drop survivals still passes (the fold scenario only adds survivals), and books with exactly 4 pair-drop survivals that survive the best-fold drop now pass where the frozen gate failed them. Tolerated scenario failures rise from 2 to 3; the survival ratio falls from 71.4% to 62.5%. The added scenario is genuinely harder on fold-concentrated books, but that does not restore the frozen failure tolerance.
findings.required_tightening: 6-of-8 minimum must BIND before any scored run (restores the frozen <= 2 tolerated failures; A1 has precommitted to accept 6/8 or 5/7-equivalent). Since finding D1 already forces a re-freeze delta, the runner constant DROPOUT_SURVIVAL_MIN 5 -> 6 should ride that same delta (preferred, verifiable); alternatively an owner-recorded, verifiable control-plane override, checked by the next audit before S0 authorization.

findings.title: Fold-drop coverage is one scenario (best fold), not the proposals' all-3-fold recomputes
findings.note: baseline_invariants v3_sample_floors and the A5 proposal (drop_one_fold: expectancy > 0 in ALL 3 single-fold recomputes) describe full fold-drop coverage; the fix implements only the best-expectancy fold drop. With unequal fold trade counts the max-expectancy fold is not always the most damaging removal, so single-best-fold is partial coverage of the frozen intent. Owner should extend to all-3 fold scenarios in the D1 remediation delta (suite would become 10 scenarios with an equivalently tightened floor) or record the deviation.
